title: Freya and the Gravity
author: Paloma Marchetti
blurb: Felix Okafor, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
